title: Lead me to the Cross
lyrics_original: Savior I come, quiet my soul, – remember
Redemptions hill where Your blood was spilled – for my ransom
Everything I once held dear I count it all as loss
Lead me to the cross where Your love poured out
Bring me to my knees Lord I lay me down
Rid me of myself, I belong to You
Lead me, Lead me to the cross
You were as I, tempted and trialed, – You are
The word became flesh, Bore my sin and death – now You're risen
Everything I once held dear I count it all as loss    ||Lead me||
To Your Heart.. To Your Heart..
Lead me to Your Heart…     ||Lead me||

bible_verses.telugu: నిశ్చ యముగా నా ప్రభువైన యేసుక్రీస్తునుగూర్చిన అతిశ్రేష్ఠమైన జ్ఞానము నిమిత్తమై సమస్తమును నష్టముగా ఎంచుకొనుచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: What is more, I consider everything a loss because of the surpassing worth of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have lost all things. I consider them garbage, that I may gain Christ.

bible_verses.telugu: మన ప్రధానయాజకుడు మన బలహీనతలయందు మనతో సహానుభవము లేనివాడు కాడు గాని, సమస్త విషయములలోను మనవలెనే శోధింపబడినను, ఆయన పాపము లేనివాడుగా ఉండెను.
bible_verses.english: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are—yet he did not sin.

bible_verses.telugu: అప్పుడు యేసు        తన శిష్యులను చూచిఎవడైనను నన్ను వెంబడింపగోరిన యెడల, తన్నుతాను ఉపేక్షించుకొని, తన సిలువనెత్తి      కొని నన్ను వెంబడింపవలెను.
bible_verses.english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, 'Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.'

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, quiet my heart today and lead me back to the cross where Your grace poured out for me. Thank You for walking in my shoes, understanding my trials, and giving Your life as my ransom. I choose to lay down my pride and surrender my heart anew to You. Rid me of my selfishness and help me live as one who truly belongs to You. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, quiet my heart today and lead me back to the cross where Your grace poured out for me. Thank You for walking in my shoes, understanding my trials, and giving Your life as my ransom. I choose to lay down my pride and surrender my heart anew to You. Rid me of my selfishness and help me live as one who truly belongs to You. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: In the busyness of life, Jesus gently invites us to quiet our souls and remember the depth of His love at the cross. When we reflect on the sacrifice He made for our redemption, the things of this world begin to lose their luster. Choosing to lay down our own desires isn't a loss, but the pathway to discovering where we truly belong. Today, let His selfless grace draw you into a place of humble worship and surrender.
